homeserver.title: Edge Infrastructure
homeserver.subtitle: Manage local network resilience, automated self-healing, and secure zero-trust edge routing.
homeserver.docker_warning: Docker service is currently offline or unreachable. Core infrastructure components cannot be managed until Docker is running.
homeserver.watchdog_desc: Monitors your local IP address for unexpected DHCP changes (such as after power outages or router reboots) and updates dependent records.
homeserver.static_desc_1: Lock your current DHCP address at the operating system level so your router cannot change it.
homeserver.static_desc_2: Incorrect values will instantly break server connectivity.
homeserver.tunnel_desc: Securely route traffic from Cloudflare's global edge directly to your local containers behind zero open firewall ports.
homeserver.alert_token_required: Please enter a valid Cloudflare Tunnel token.
homeserver.alert_fields_required: All fields are required. Check your IP, Gateway, and Interface name.
homeserver.confirm_static: DANGER: Are you sure you want to lock interface %s to %s? If this is incorrect, you will lose SSH access to the server.
homeserver.error_network: Connection lost. The IP may have changed successfully!
homeserver.alert_watchdog_update: Failed to update IP Watchdog settings.

security.title: Uncomplicated Firewall (UFW)
security.subtitle: Manage inbound network traffic rules
security.cf_desc: Fetches the latest Cloudflare Edge IP ranges, configures Nginx to unmask visitor IPs, and configures UFW to block all non-Cloudflare traffic on ports 80 and 443.
security.f2b_desc: Automatically scans log files and bans IP addresses that show malicious signs.
security.f2b_port_desc: The port your SSH daemon listens on.
security.f2b_retries_desc: Ban if there are [Max Retries] failures within [Window] minutes.
security.f2b_bantime_desc: Set to -1 for a permanent ban (use with caution!).
security.confirm_delete:
🚨 WARNING: Are you sure you want to delete the rule for Port %s?

If this is your WireGuard or SSH port, you might drop your connection.
security.confirm_disable_ufw: 🚨 DANGER: Are you sure you want to DISABLE the firewall? Your server will be fully exposed.
security.confirm_enable_ufw: 🛡️ Enabling Firewall: Claviger will automatically inject safety rules for SSH and VPN before applying.
security.prompt_port: Enter the Port or Service to Allow (e.g., 80, 443, 8080/tcp):
security.alert_action_fail: Action failed. Check terminal logs for permissions.
security.confirm_install_ufw: This will install the UFW firewall on your server via APT. Do you want to proceed?
security.success_install_ufw: ✅ UFW installed successfully! The page will now refresh.
security.fail_install_ufw: ❌ Failed to install UFW. Please check the server logs.
security.confirm_unban: Are you sure you want to pardon and unban %s?
security.confirm_install_f2b: This will install Fail2Ban on your server via APT. Do you want to proceed?
security.success_f2b_save: Fail2Ban rules updated and service restarted successfully!
security.confirm_cf_lockdown: This will configure UFW to drop all internet traffic on ports 80 and 443 unless it originates from Cloudflare. Continue?
security.confirm_revert: This will REOPEN ports 80/443 to the entire internet. Are you sure?

roles.title: Role Management
roles.subtitle: Define network access policies and micro-segmentation rules.
roles.banner_desc: Roles define exact network boundaries. Use Quick Toggles to grant broad access (Internet, Intranet, or the Hub), and use Granular Filters to restrict traffic to specific IPs or Ports. The Claviger Daemon translates these into live Linux Kernel firewall rules instantly.
roles.toggle_internet_desc: Allow traffic to the public internet (Google, YouTube, etc).
roles.toggle_intranet_desc: Allow traffic to other devices securely connected to this server.
roles.toggle_hub_desc: Allow access to this admin dashboard. (Warning: Admin level).
roles.confirm_delete:
🚨 Are you sure you want to delete the '%s' role?

This will fail if users are currently assigned to it.

access.title: System Access
access.subtitle: Manage OS-level SSH keys and root-level administrative access.
access.warning_desc:
SSH keys grant direct OS-level access to this server. Anyone with a corresponding private key can bypass the Claviger Hub and execute terminal commands. Only grant SSH access to trusted system administrators.

Note: If Shield Mode is active, users must be connected to the Claviger VPN to use their SSH keys.
access.prompt_add: Paste the full public SSH key (e.g., ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3... user@machine):
access.confirm_revoke: 🚨 Are you sure you want to revoke SSH access for '%s'?

mfa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
mfa.subtitle: Manage your Zero Trust session and global gateway security.
mfa.enhance_desc: Add an extra layer of protection. Even if your device is compromised, unauthorized users cannot access the Hub without your phone.
mfa.scan_steps:
1. Open your authenticator app.
2. Scan the QR code.
3. Enter the 6-digit code below to verify.
mfa.warning_codes: ⚠️ Save these backup codes! They will only be shown once.
mfa.secured_desc: Two-Factor Authentication is currently active for your device.
mfa.global_policy_desc: Require all connected devices to verify an authenticator code before accessing the Hub.
mfa.danger_desc: Remove authenticator from your account. This will downgrade your security.
mfa.err_load_status: Failed to load status. Check server logs.
mfa.confirm_remove: Are you sure? Removing MFA will log you out of your elevated session immediately.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.subtitle: Enhance your Edge Node with 1-click self-hosted applications.
extensions.modal_desc: Paste your docker-compose YAML. Traffic will be routed securely via the tunnel.

extensions.placeholder_desc: A brief description of this service...

extensions.deployments_subtitle: Unverified applications deployed via custom YAML.

peers.subtitle: Manage Zero Trust devices and role-based routing.
peers.modal_desktop_desc: Paste the Connection Request Token provided by the user's Claviger Client app.

peers.modal_mobile_desc: Enter a name for this device and assign a role. Claviger will securely generate the keys and display a QR code.
peers.routing_desc: Route all internet traffic through the VPN. Leave unchecked (Split Tunnel) to save battery and bypass carrier restrictions.

network.title: Network & Gateway
network.routing_desc: When enabled, WireGuard clients route their public internet traffic (like Google or YouTube) through this server. When disabled, clients are strictly isolated to the private 10.8.0.x network.
network.disabled_desc: You currently have public web hosting disabled. Claviger is operating strictly as a private, isolated network gateway.
network.hosting_active_desc: Master Gateway is managing public internet traffic.
network.cf_desc: Claviger will automatically sync Real-IP lists and configure Nginx to strictly accept traffic from Cloudflare Edge networks.
network.std_desc: You are managing your own DNS records. Ensure your domain A-Records point directly to this server's public IP.
network.docker_missing_desc: Gateway applications require Docker to run securely in isolated containers. Please install Docker on your server to enable Master Gateway and AdGuard Home deployments.
network.npm_desc: Acts as the front door for all incoming internet traffic. Provides free automated SSL certificates and routes subdomains securely to your Claviger apps.
network.npm_req_desc: Ports 80 and 443 must be available on your server. If you have an existing Nginx container, please map it to an internal port before initializing.
network.adguard_desc: A network-wide software for blocking ads, tracking, and malware. When installed, it acts as the primary DNS resolver.
network.adguard_setup_hint: When setup is complete, ignore AdGuard's final button and just close the tab.
network.endpoint_desc: The IP or Domain clients use to connect to this server.
network.endpoint_placeholder: Enter new IP or Domain (e.g., vpn.mydomain.com)
network.endpoint_warning:
Safe Action: Changing this setting will not disconnect existing peers. However, it will change the connection address generated for all future peers and QR codes.
Note: If you use a custom domain, you must purchase it and point the A-Record to this server's public IP.
network.dns_modal_hint:
If you recently purchased this domain or updated your Cloudflare settings, DNS propagation can take up to 30 minutes.

If you are confident your settings are correct and you just need to wait for propagation, you can override this safety check.
network.modal_proxy_desc: Select how you want to route internet traffic to your Master Gateway. You can change this later.
network.cf_choice_desc: Free SSL, DDoS protection, and CDN caching. Claviger will lock down Nginx to strictly accept traffic only from Cloudflare Edge networks.
network.std_choice_desc: You manage your own DNS records directly. Use this if you are using an internal local domain or an unsupported proxy service.
network.confirm_update_endpoint:
Update endpoint to %s?

All new QR codes will use this address.
network.confirm_disable_proxy: Are you sure you want to disable Web App Hosting? Nginx will be stopped and you will return to internal VPN routing only.
network.error_save_proxy: Failed to save proxy settings. Check logs.
